extension.description: A secure, local-first coding agent powered by your ClawAI backend.
capabilities.untrusted: Chat and read-only review remain available. Workspace collection and file changes are disabled until you trust the workspace.
command.registerRunner: Register This Machine as a Runner
command.pairDevice: Pair This Editor From Your Phone
command.moveChatToSecondarySideBar: Move Chat to Secondary Side Bar
command.postReviewComment: Post Review Comment to GitHub or GitLab
config.backendUrl: ClawAI backend origin. Tokens and credentials must not be included in this URL.
config.pluginMarketplaces: Plugin marketplaces to browse: an https URL of a `clawai-marketplace.json` catalog, or a local folder that contains one. Each plugin is checked against the sha256 its catalog pins before it is installed. A project policy `allowedPluginMarketplaces` list refuses any marketplace it does not name.
config.hooks: Commands to run at points in a run. Configured here rather than in `.clawai` on purpose: a hook runs a command, and reading one from workspace content would make cloning a repository enough to execute code. Only a `before-tool` hook marked `blocking` can stop a call; everything else is advisory.
config.outputStyle: How answers are written: default, concise, explanatory, learning, or a style this workspace defines.
config.viewDensity: Show the whole cockpit, or only the conversation and composer.
config.backendEnvironment: Choose the local, cloud, or custom ClawAI backend.
config.backendCustomUrl: Custom ClawAI backend URL used when the backend environment is Custom.
config.frontendEnvironment: Choose the local, cloud, or custom ClawAI frontend used for browser authorization.
config.frontendCustomUrl: Custom ClawAI frontend URL used when the frontend environment is Custom.
config.requestTimeoutMs: Maximum duration for a backend request in milliseconds.
config.telemetryEndpoint: OTLP traces endpoint to send run spans to, such as your own collector. Empty means nothing is sent. Must be HTTPS unless it is on this machine.
config.telemetryHeaders: Headers sent with each telemetry export, such as an authorization header your collector requires.
config.browserOrigins: Extra site origins the browser tool may open without asking, such as your own development server. The backend and frontend origins are always allowed and cannot be removed here.
config.zeroDataRetention: Zero data retention: run journals and checkpoints stay in memory for this session only, every request asks the backend not to retain content, and uploads, published pages and chat shares are refused. An organization whose retention limit is zero days turns this on for you.
config.autoCompact: What to do when a conversation is nearly too long to continue: nothing, offer to summarize it, or summarize it automatically.
config.routingMode: How the backend picks a model: automatic, a named strategy, or one you select yourself.
config.mcpServers: User-level MCP servers, by name. Each is either a local server (`command`, `args`, `env`, `cwd`) or a remote one (`url`, optional `headers` and `oauth`). Workspace servers go in `.clawai/mcp.json`; a user server wins a name clash. Local servers run only in a trusted workspace, and every tool listing and call asks first.
config.agentMode: Choose automatic execution or read-only planning.
config.speedMode: How many workspace metadata lookups run at once while building context. Byte reads stay serial; approvals, writes, commands and the included file set are never affected.
config.effortMode: How much a run may spend: model turns, tool calls, wall clock and output size. Ultra is the default and matches the fixed budget used before effort modes existed.
config.permissionMode: Control approvals for workspace context and edit generation. Final diff review is always required.
config.commandSandbox.mode: Sandbox for agent shell commands. off: bounded only. auto: strongest available (bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS, else docker when an image is set), reporting 'none' when nothing exists. A named mechanism is required: commands are refused if it is unavailable.
config.commandSandbox.dockerImage: Container image used when the command sandbox is docker (or auto finds no OS sandbox). Empty disables docker.
config.commandSandbox.allowNetwork: Allow network access inside the command sandbox. Off by default.
config.selectedModel: Manual model selection encoded as provider:model.
config.autosave: Save unsaved changes to the files an edit touches before ClawAI reviews them.
config.maxContextBytes: Maximum total UTF-8 bytes collected as workspace context.
config.maxContextFiles: Maximum files collected as workspace context.
config.exclude: Glob patterns excluded from workspace context.
config.historyLimit: Maximum recent conversations shown by the extension.
welcome.model: Choose AUTO routing or a model exposed by your ClawAI backend.
welcome.context: Context receipts appear here after you ask about code.
welcome.history: Your recent ClawAI threads appear here after you connect.
